name: nodejs.remove
description: Remove one side-installed Node.js major by moving /opt/node/NN to /var/backups/node-remove/NN-vX.Y.Z-<UTC time>, from where nodejs.restore puts it back. It refuses if /opt/node/NN isn't installed, a running process's executable is under it, or a file in /etc/supervisor/conf.d, /etc/systemd/system (drop-ins included), /etc/cron.d, /var/spool/cron/crontabs or /etc/crontab, or a pm2 dump (/home/*/.pm2/dump.pm2, /root/.pm2/dump.pm2) names it. It never touches the host's NodeSource node.

major.description: The Node.js major to remove, two digits, such as 20.

health_check: The helper confirms /opt/node/NN is gone and its backup is in place.
